questions.text: Locate the generic shortest_path dispatcher.

targets.name: shortest_path
targets.rationale: Selects all-pairs, single-source, single-target or pairwise algorithms based on arguments and weighting.

questions.text: Find the connected_components generator for undirected graphs.

targets.name: connected_components
targets.rationale: Runs BFS from unseen nodes and yields each connected component.

questions.text: Where is topological_sort implemented?

targets.name: topological_sort
targets.rationale: Yields nodes from successive topological generations.

questions.text: Locate bfs_edges, including its reverse traversal option.

targets.name: bfs_edges
targets.rationale: Selects predecessors or neighbors and delegates edge generation to generic_bfs_edges.

questions.text: Which undirected graph method automatically creates missing endpoint nodes and rejects None as a node?

targets.name: Graph.add_edge
targets.rationale: Initializes missing node and adjacency dictionaries, rejects None and stores the edge in both directions.

questions.text: Where does removing an undirected self-loop avoid deleting the same adjacency entry twice?

targets.name: Graph.remove_edge
targets.rationale: Deletes the reverse entry only when u differs from v and translates missing edges to NetworkXError.

questions.text: Which unweighted pairwise path function rejects an absent source or target before searching?

targets.name: bidirectional_shortest_path
targets.rationale: Checks membership of both endpoints and raises NodeNotFound with an explicit message.

questions.text: Which generation iterator detects leftover positive indegrees and raises an error for a cycle or graph mutation?

targets.name: topological_generations
targets.rationale: Raises NetworkXUnfeasible if indegree_map remains after the zero-indegree frontier is exhausted.

questions.text: Where does breadth-first traversal enforce a depth limit and stop after every node has been discovered?

targets.name: generic_bfs_edges
targets.rationale: Bounds its frontier loop by depth_limit and returns when the seen count equals the graph size.

questions.text: Which implementation counts connected components without first materializing them into a list?

targets.name: number_connected_components
targets.rationale: Sums one per yielded connected component.

questions.text: Which predicate requires a graph to be directed as well as cycle-free?

targets.name: is_directed_acyclic_graph
targets.rationale: Returns G.is_directed() and not has_cycle(G).

questions.text: Where are graph, node and edge attributes deep-copied when reversing a directed graph with copy=True?

targets.name: DiGraph.reverse
targets.rationale: Creates a new graph and deep-copies graph, node and reversed-edge attributes in the copy branch.

questions.text: Trace the generic pairwise shortest-path API to the unweighted bidirectional implementation when weight is None.

targets.name: shortest_path
targets.rationale: Chooses unweighted mode and delegates a source/target pair to nx.bidirectional_shortest_path.

targets.name: bidirectional_shortest_path
targets.rationale: Runs the bidirectional predecessor/successor search and reconstructs the resulting path.

questions.text: Which ancestor query delegates to breadth-first traversal with edges reversed, and where is that direction selected?

targets.name: ancestors
targets.rationale: Collects child nodes from nx.bfs_edges with reverse=True.

targets.name: bfs_edges
targets.rationale: Uses G.predecessors for reverse traversal on directed graphs.

questions.text: Trace descendant lookup into the traversal function that walks outward from a source.

targets.name: descendants
targets.rationale: Collects child nodes from the default-direction BFS edge iterator.

targets.name: bfs_edges
targets.rationale: Selects neighbors in ordinary traversal and invokes the generic BFS implementation.

questions.text: Which Graph method creates a node-induced view, and which separate implementation installs the filtering wrappers?

targets.name: Graph.subgraph
targets.rationale: Creates the node filter and calls nx.subgraph_view, reusing an original graph when appropriate.

targets.name: subgraph_view
targets.rationale: Builds a frozen graph view and installs filtered node and adjacency structures.

questions.text: Trace reverse(copy=False) to the view implementation that swaps predecessor and successor mappings.

targets.name: DiGraph.reverse
targets.rationale: Delegates to nx.reverse_view when copying is disabled.

targets.name: reverse_view
targets.rationale: Creates a generic view and swaps the original predecessor and successor mappings.

questions.text: Which path-graph generator uses a utility from another module to connect consecutive nodes?

targets.name: path_graph
targets.rationale: Creates an empty graph and adds edges generated by pairwise(nodes).

targets.name: pairwise
targets.rationale: Uses offset iterators to return successive node pairs.

questions.text: Trace composing two graphs into the multi-graph composition helper that preserves their attributes.

targets.name: compose
targets.rationale: Delegates the pair to nx.compose_all.

targets.name: compose_all
targets.rationale: Checks graph types and updates graph, node and edge attributes for each input.

questions.text: Which JSON adjacency serializer consumes the graph method exposing each node's adjacency mapping?

targets.name: adjacency_data
targets.rationale: Iterates G.adjacency to populate node and neighbor records.

targets.name: Graph.adjacency
targets.rationale: Returns an iterator over the internal adjacency dictionary items.

questions.text: Which Graph test verifies adding an edge creates both adjacency directions and rejects a None endpoint?

targets.name: TestGraph.test_add_edge
targets.rationale: Asserts symmetric adjacency after insertion and checks ValueError for a None node.

questions.text: Which parameterized path test requires NodeNotFound when either endpoint is absent?

targets.name: TestUnweightedPath.test_bidirectional_shortest_path_src_tgt_not_in_graph
targets.rationale: Tries missing source/target combinations and checks the exact NodeNotFound message.

questions.text: Which test checks the same topological generations for a directed graph and its multigraph variant with an extra parallel edge?

targets.name: test_topological_generations
targets.rationale: Builds both graphs and verifies their sorted generations equal the same expected layers.

questions.text: Find the test checking that multigraph composition preserves distinct edge keys, including an additional overlapping-node edge.

targets.name: test_compose_multigraph
targets.rationale: Compares node and keyed-edge unions before and after adding another keyed edge to the second graph.
